title: fix(app-shell): the record page tells a refused read and a failed load apart from not-found (objectui#11902)
body:
Fixes #11902

Clause-②: no. A console page's own states and copy, plus additive locale rows. No export, prop, `@object-ui/types` member or accepted input changes.

## What changes

`RecordDetailView`'s record load (the effect that sets `pageRecordStatus`) mapped every rejection to `missing`, which renders "Record not found. The record you are looking for does not exist or may have been deleted." It now maps the door's answer to its own state, per triage's direction on the card:

| the read's answer | state | copy (EN) | Retry |
|---|---|---|---|
| resolves with a record | `loaded` | the page, as before | none |
| resolves with no record (how the adapter answers a 404) | `missing` | "Record not found …", unchanged | none |
| rejects, and `classifyLoadError` answers `forbidden` (a 403 or `PERMISSION_DENIED`) | `forbidden` | "You don’t have access to OBJECT records" / "You don’t have permission to view records of this type. Contact your administrator if you think you should have access." | none |
| rejects with any other kind (a 5xx, a transport error, …) | `failed` | "Couldn’t load this record" / "Something went wrong while loading it. Check your connection and try again." | yes |

- **One classifier.** The rejection is classified by the shared `classifyLoadError` from `@object-ui/react`, the one the list view's error panel, the activity feed, the attachments panel and objectui#11878's readability probe read. The page reads no status or code of its own.
- **The refusal names the object, not the record.** OBJECT is the object's label through the page's own `objectLabel`, so it is localized. The copy says nothing about whether the record exists. No Retry: retrying a permission decision cannot change it.
- **Retry is the same read.** The button calls the effect's own `loadRecord` through a ref the effect sets and clears, so it re-runs the same request under the same cancellation guard. There is no second read path.
- **Locale rows.** Four new rows sit beside `recordNotFound` in the `empty` namespace of all ten packs: `recordAccessDenied`, `recordAccessDeniedDescription`, `recordLoadFailed`, `recordLoadFailedDescription`. The Retry label is the existing `common.retry`.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/11902-record-read-failure.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Measured first (the order's H1 to H3)

Harness: the real `RecordDetailView` over the real `ObjectStackAdapter` (client 17.7.0). Only the HTTP transport is doubled, answering the record reads per case. One object has a lookup, so the page's read takes the `$expand` path, and one has none. It ran on the base `3683591` before the fix, then on the fix.

- **H1, confirmed.**
  - A 403 with `code: PERMISSION_DENIED` rejects `findOne` with a plain `Error` carrying `httpStatus` 403 and that code, on both read paths. Before the fix the page rendered "Record not found … may have been deleted".
  - A 404 RESOLVES `null` on both paths (the `$expand` list read and the by-id GET, through the adapter's `is404Error`). So the not-found leg stays not-found without any status read in the page.
  - A 500 rejects with `httpStatus` 500, and a transport failure with the `TypeError` that `fetch` threw. Both rendered not-found before the fix.
- **H2.** Inside `RecordDetailView`, only this effect's mapping renders the record-not-found copy.
  - The `!objectDef` branch ("Object Not Found") is fed by the metadata object list, not by the record read. It appeared in no case above.
  - `plugin-detail`'s `DetailView` carries its own not-found copy and maps every rejection to it. It is fenced out of this card (see Acceptance notes). On the record page it did not surface for a 403 in this harness: the page's own state replaces the page.
- **H3, the two reads are the adapter's, not the page re-reading.**
  - One page `findOne` with `$expand` sends the populate list read, filtered by id. When that fails with anything but a 404, `readOne` falls back to `GET /api/v1/data/OBJ/ID`, which fails the same way. That is two wire requests for one page read; without a lookup there is one.
  - The fix adds no read. A refusal is read once, and Retry is one more `findOne` with identical arguments. Both are pinned.
  - This is a jsdom reading with the real adapter, not a browser re-run of objectui#11878's stack.

## Tests

New pin file `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.recordReadFailure-11902.test.tsx`. It uses the real page, the real adapter and a real `I18nProvider`, and reads the copy from the packs:

- **403.** The no-access state names the object, in EN ("You don’t have access to Invoice records") and in ZH ("无权访问发票记录", with the object label translated to 发票). There is no "Record not found", no "may have been deleted" and no Retry, and the page read once.
- **5xx.** "Couldn’t load this record" with Retry. After the server recovers, Retry re-runs the identical read once and the record renders. A transport failure gives the same state. ZH: "无法加载此记录" with "重试".
- **Controls.** A 404 renders today's not-found copy. A found record renders the page with none of the three states.

**Reverse check.** The fix was committed first (`a459ec5`). `/home/user/objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` ran in wrap mode under the verify lock and restored the bare mapping:
- Anchor `setPageRecordStatus(classifyLoadError(err) === 'forbidden' ? 'forbidden' : 'failed');` became `setPageRecordStatus('missing');`. Anchor x1 to x0, replacement x1 to x2, blob `0d3dd8ac4a99` to `e2e893d995aa`.
- Predicted 5 red and 2 green. Observed `Tests 5 failed | 2 passed (7)`: both 403 pins and all three failure pins went red, and each DOM dump shows the not-found copy. Both controls stayed green.
- Restore: the blob after equals the HEAD blob `0d3dd8ac4a99`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

**Gate union on `4fd3b12`** (the fix plus a merge of `main` `d52d908`). Each line is command, exit, verdict:
- One verify-lock call, lock verdict `command-exit 0`:
  - `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`: 0 (Scope: 29 of 47 workspace projects).
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: 0. Its `tsconfig.test.json` lists the new pin file (`tsc --listFilesOnly`).
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check`: 0.
  - `pnpm exec vitest run` over every `RecordDetailView*` test, the whole `packages/i18n/` and the one `*.guard.test.*` under `packages/app-shell/src/views`: 0, `Test Files 127 passed (127)`, `Tests 1599 passed | 13 skipped (1612)`. 127 is 44 + 82 + 1 by `git ls-files`.
- Console closure build for the bundle gates: `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/console...' --filter '!@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`: 0 (Scope: 7 of 47).
- `check:eager-locale-catalogues` 0: "Exactly one locale catalogue is eager — `en`, the resident fallback". `check:eager-closure` 0: "Console eager closure is 3304.8 KB gzipped … (budget: 3307.0 KB, headroom: 2.2 KB)".
- `check:control-bytes` 0 (OK). `check:new-line-citations` 0 (0 new citations). `check:changeset-claims` 0 ("No pending changeset names a file this change touches."). `check:pending-changeset-literals` 0.
- `check:i18n-keys` 0 (every call-site key resolves, every inline `defaultValue` matches the pack). `check:i18n-dead-keys` 0 (report; none of the four new keys listed). `check:i18n-drift` 0 ("No en value changed in this range"; 4 keys added).
- Added from the diff: `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: all 0.
- **Lint, narrowed and measured.** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 12 touched TS/TSX files reported 12 files, 0 errors and 111 warnings, all in `RecordDetailView.tsx`. Its per-rule warning counts are identical to the base version linted over stdin, so there are no new warnings. The root `eslint.config.js` sets no `project`/`projectService` (no type-aware linting), so this diff cannot move an untouched file's verdict. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **`plugin-detail`'s `DetailView` shows the same defect by source, not measured through a public door.** Its own read catches every rejection into `null`, retries an alternate id, then catches again into `setData(null)`. That renders `detail.recordNotFound` ("may have been deleted") for a refused or failed read wherever it reads by itself. It is fenced out of this card; reported, not touched.
- **Only `forbidden` is told apart, per the three answers ruled.** A 401, a 400 or an object whose API method is disabled (`classifyLoadError`'s `unauthorized` / `rejected` / `api-disabled`) renders the load-failure state with Retry. A retry cannot help a 400 or an `api-disabled` answer.
- **A 404 that REJECTS would render the load-failure state.** No in-tree adapter does that: `ObjectStackAdapter` resolves `null`, and `ValueDataSource` returns `null`. The `DataSource.findOne` contract resolves "the record or null". Reading a 404 status in the page is what the ruling ⛔ forbids, so it is left to the adapter contract.
- **`ApiDataSource.findOne` swallows every error into `null`.** On that adapter a refused read still renders not-found. That is adapter-level and outside this fence.
- **Locale packs.** EN and ZH were written properly, and the other eight are translated too. What the checks would accept: `all-locales-key-parity` needs every key in every pack, and `untranslated-identity-4376` refuses a value byte-identical to `en` in zh, ja, ko, ru and ar. An English fallback would therefore pass mechanically only in de, fr, es and pt, which nothing reads for identity.
- **The no-access title.** Triage's literal "You don't have access to this record" was narrowed by the order's ruling that the copy names the object, not the record. Hence "You don’t have access to OBJECT records".
